  "description": "Our client, a leading large-scale diversified corporation with extensive business operations across multiple sectors, is seeking an experienced and commercially minded Tax Director to lead its group-wide tax strategy, governance and compliance.
Reporting directly to the Chief Financial Officer (CFO), the successful candidate will play a key role in shaping the organisation's tax strategy, managing tax risks and ensuring compliance with Vietnamese tax regulations, while supporting business growth and strategic initiatives.
This position requires a strong combination of technical tax expertise, strategic thinking and practical business acumen. The ideal candidate will bring both the technical depth of a Big Four tax professional and the practical business perspective of an experienced in-house tax leader. Be comfortable engaging with senior leadership, advising on complex business decisions and working across multiple business entities in a large, diversified corporate environment.
Key Responsibilities
1. Tax Strategy & Planning
  * Develop and implement the Group's overall tax strategy, ensuring alignment with business objectives and long-term financial priorities.
  * Identify opportunities for tax optimisation and develop commercially sound tax structures within the applicable legal and regulatory framework.
  * Provide tax advice and strategic recommendations to the CFO and senior management on business transactions, investments, restructuring and other strategic initiatives.
  * Assess the tax implications of new business activities, corporate structures and major commercial decisions.
  * Monitor developments in tax legislation and evaluate their potential impact on the organisation.


2. Tax Compliance & Governance
  * Oversee tax compliance across the Group and its subsidiaries, ensuring accurate and timely fulfilment of all statutory tax obligations.
  * Establish and maintain effective tax policies, procedures and internal controls across the organisation.
  * Ensure compliance with Vietnamese tax laws and regulations, including corporate income tax, VAT, personal income tax, foreign contractor tax and other relevant tax obligations.
  * Ensure consistency and appropriate governance of tax practices across business units.
  * Drive continuous improvement in tax processes, reporting and controls.


3. Tax Risk Management & Authorities
  * Lead the management of tax risks, audits, inspections and disputes across the Group.
  * Oversee engagement with Vietnamese tax authorities and external advisors on complex tax matters.
  * Develop appropriate risk mitigation strategies and ensure consistent tax governance across business units.
  * Resolve complex tax issues and provide guidance on regulatory interpretations and tax positions.
  * Anticipate potential tax exposures and ensure appropriate measures are in place to protect the organisation's financial and business interests.


4. Business Partnership & Strategic Advisory
  * Work closely with Finance, Legal and business leadership teams across the Group to provide tax guidance and support business decisions.
  * Partner with business units to assess tax implications of operational changes, commercial arrangements and investment projects.
  * Provide tax input into M&A transactions, business restructuring, capital investments and other corporate development activities.
  * Evaluate tax implications of major contracts, financing arrangements and cross-border transactions.
  * Translate complex tax matters into practical recommendations for senior management, balancing regulatory requirements with commercial objectives.


5. Leadership & Stakeholder Management
  * Lead and develop the Group's tax function, establishing clear priorities, accountability and professional standards.
  * Build effective working relationships with CFOs, Finance Directors and other senior stakeholders across the Group's business units.
  * Manage relationships with external tax advisors, auditors and relevant regulatory authorities.
  * Provide guidance and technical support to finance teams across the organisation.
  * Promote a proactive tax management culture focused on compliance, efficiency and business partnership.",
